messages:
julia: Heads-up: we've marked the hosted realtime + tool-calling feature as STABLE and are beginning a controlled rollout. This includes new lightweight tracing, a lower realtime default batching_window, and a soft rate-limit layer to smooth tail-latency. Deploying now to canary. :tada:
max: Nice. Which metrics should we watch first?
julia: Priorities: p95 latency, queue_length_breakdown by model_variant, and 429 rate. Also watch cold-starts for quantized models.
tara: Ops note: tracing adds span tags service=hosted-realtime, route_id, and model_variant. Staging will begin collecting in ~15m. To opt-out for a route: curl -X POST "$REDWOOD_API/admin/routes/ROUTE_ID/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix_sampling": false}'

max: Will customers see more 429s?
julia: You may see earlier 429s when queues build, but overall fewer timeouts/ooms and more stable p95s. We added queue_length_breakdown per variant to help debug.
leon: Any customer notices needed? Legal/CS?
julia: Yes 1: SLAs unchanged. We'll post a customer notice and provide a 30-day opt-out for Dedicated tenants. @tara, can CS/Legal review the copy?
tara: I will. Also: legacy websocket multiplexer is being deprecated in 90 days. It remains functional but won't get new instrumentation. Migration guide (ws -> unified-stream) will be posted this afternoon.
ops-bot: ops-bot: hosted-realtime v2.0 promoted to canary in us-east-1  build 2026.03.22.0900  status: started
julia: Rollout plan: 10% in canary region, monitor for 4-6 hours, then gradual expansion. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 > 230ms OR queue > 500.
max: I'll watch cold-start errors for quantized variants and report any client regressions with route_id + repro.
julia: Thanks all  please drop quick notes here for any issues. Summary: stable marking for realtime/tool-calling, new tracing, lowered realtime batching_window, soft-rate-limits, legacy ws deprecation in 90 days, canary active now. :rocket:
